brand.name: Kstar
brand.notes: Chinese maker (Shenzhen, SZSE 002518) selling online UPS plus PV inverter and ESS under KSTAR New Energy. Kstar's own news page lists it as a top UPS brand in Pakistan and recommends it as an OEM for Pakistani UPS importers, so units are common in the local channel even though Kstar has no .pk site. No Kstar UPS fault table was readable (kstar.com is WAF-blocked), so every code below is from the KSTAR New Energy solar/ESS manuals.

series.name: Memopower UDC One series online UPS (UDC9101S / UDC9101H tower, 1-3kVA)
